# three.js add-ons (vendored)

Copied unchanged from `three@0.169.0` `examples/jsm`, keeping the folder
layout (they import each other by relative path). They live here because the
desktop build leaves `node_modules/three/examples` out, and the game serves
them at `/vendor/three/addons/`. MIT licensed, see `LICENSE`.

When three.js is upgraded, copy the same files again from
`node_modules/three/examples/jsm`.
